title: UpKeep Board Footer Deck
request: Oct 19 2026 12:02 ICT (relayed by UpKeep Develop): Max wants this-or-that decks to choose the Smart Upkeep branded header and footer for the four UpKeep agent boards (Members, Technicians, Tools & Equipment, Scheduling); Command Center left out, undecided. 12:07 decided: the footer holds the ping schedule and Ping Record plus Routines; board footer reads Built by Machan.
example_data: Laptop browser mockups (1366 wide) of the Members board footer: Ping Record, ping schedule, Routines, Built by Machan line, Share. Invented SAMPLE data. No real names, addresses or phones.
built_at_note: UpKeep board decks, Oct 19 2026 12:02-12:07 ICT requests
brands: Standard deck look (white, light beige accents, Khand/Hind)
Mockups: white/cream base, terracotta, lagoon and jungle accents, UP house mark, light only
